_comment: Approved tool baselines for MCP Tool Poisoning Defense. Each tool's approved description is fingerprinted; if a tool later presents a DIFFERENT description than the approved baseline, that is a 'rug pull' (silently modified after approval) and is blocked. 'server' must be on the trusted list. Tools not listed here are 'unknown' and warned.

tools.name: web_search
tools.approved_description: Search the web for a query string and return text results.

tools.name: read_file
tools.approved_description: Read the contents of a file at a given path within the workspace.

tools.name: calculator
tools.approved_description: Evaluate a basic arithmetic expression and return the numeric result.

tools.name: send_email
tools.approved_description: Send an email to a specified recipient with a subject and body.
